description_en: Queries models in a specified workspace by using paging. Supports filtering by model connection and model name
description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间中的模型，支持按模型连接和模型名称筛选
name: ListModels

parameters.help_en: The number of results per page. Valid values: 0 to 100. If this parameter is not set or set to 0, the default value 10 is used
parameters.help_zh: 单页返回数量。取值范围为 0～100，未设置或设置为 0 时默认为 10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Pass the token returned from the previous query. An empty response indicates that no more pages are available
parameters.help_zh: 分页令牌。请求时传入上一次查询返回的令牌；响应为空表示没有下一页
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The model connection ID used to filter models
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选模型的模型连接 ID
parameters.name: connection_id

schema.description_en: The model text response returned when the model test succeeds. This value is empty when the test fails
schema.description_zh: 模型调试成功时返回的模型文本响应；调试失败时为空

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of SUCCESS indicates success
code.description_zh: 业务状态码。成功时为 SUCCESS

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. A value of 200 indicates success

items.description_en: The business value of this field

audio.description_en: Indicates whether the model supports audio input or output
audio.description_zh: 模型是否支持音频输入或输出

document.description_en: Indicates whether the model supports document input
document.description_zh: 模型是否支持文档输入

multiToolCall.description_en: Indicates whether the model supports invoking multiple tools in a single response
multiToolCall.description_zh: 模型是否支持在一次响应中发起多个工具调用

reasoning.description_en: Indicates whether the model supports reasoning capabilities
reasoning.description_zh: 模型是否支持推理能力

streamToolCall.description_en: Indicates whether the model supports streaming tool calling
streamToolCall.description_zh: 模型是否支持流式工具调用

toolCall.description_en: Indicates whether the model supports tool calling
toolCall.description_zh: 模型是否支持工具调用

video.description_en: Indicates whether the model supports video input
video.description_zh: 模型是否支持视频输入

vision.description_en: Indicates whether the model supports image input
vision.description_zh: 模型是否支持图像输入

contextSize.description_en: The model context window size, in tokens. The value must be a positive integer
contextSize.description_zh: 模型上下文窗口大小，单位为 Token，必须为正整数

createdAt.description_en: The time when the resource was created, in RFC 3339 UTC format
createdAt.description_zh: 资源创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

description.description_en: The model description. Maximum length: 255 characters
description.description_zh: 模型描述，最长 255 个字符

maxTokens.description_en: The maximum number of output tokens supported by the model in a single generation
maxTokens.description_zh: 模型单次生成支持的最大输出 Token 数
maxTokens.title_en: 模型单次生成支持的最大输出 Token 数
maxTokens.title_zh: 模型单次生成支持的最大输出 Token 数

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the resource was last updated, in RFC 3339 UTC format
updatedAt.description_zh: 资源最后更新时间，采用 RFC 3339 UTC 格式

maxResults.description_en: The number of results per page. Valid values: 0 to 100. If this parameter is not set or set to 0, the default value 10 is used
maxResults.description_zh: 单页返回数量。取值范围为 0～100，未设置或设置为 0 时默认为 10

message.description_en: The message of the request processing result

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token. Pass the token returned from the previous query. An empty response indicates that no more pages are available
nextToken.description_zh: 分页令牌。请求时传入上一次查询返回的令牌；响应为空表示没有下一页

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

totalCount.description_en: The total number of resources that match the query conditions
totalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的资源总数
